text:
sara: Quick heads-up, PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4489 failed preview. Linkcheck + md-lint. Need a fast fix before the afternoon merge window.

tom: Which files?

sara: /guides/upgrade-path.md has a broken anchor to `#api-changes`, looks like the heading changed to `API differences` -> anchor `#api-differences`. Also md-lint: MD013 on a long paragraph in /reference/sdk/go.md. Preview log: 
```
LinkCheckError: /guides/upgrade-path.md: anchor not found: api-changes
MD013: /reference/sdk/go.md: line 142
```

maya: I can patch the xref to `#api-differences` on your branch. Small commit.

tom: I'll tighten that paragraph and add an md-lint ignore around the adjacent code block if needed. Won't change code fences.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #610 failed : 2 errors (1 link, 1 md-lint).

maya: Pushed commit a1b4c: update anchor to #api-differences and fixed a typo. Triggering preview.

doc-bot: New commit on PR 4489 by maya. Rerunning preview...

ci-bot: docs-preview build #611 queued.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #611 succeeded.

tom: Pushed MD013 fix (shortened sentence, kept code block intact).

ci-bot: docs-preview build #612 queued.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #612 succeeded.

sara: Can someone approve and merge? Prefer squash so changelog is clean. I can give edit access if needed.

maya: Approved.

tom: I'll merge fast-forward now.

doc-bot: PR 4489 merged by tom at 1766010205.

sara: Thanks all! Will watch site crawl tonight and flag anything else. :white_check_mark:
